summary: One glossary change to decide: term/check.
questions: Glossary change `term/check`: shall the glossary entry change? Now: `- **check**: a command a work-item names in place of scenarios, whose exit code 0 shows its work complete. Not: criterion.` Drafted: `- **check**: a command a work-item names in place of scenarios, whose JSON output holding `ok` true shows its work complete. Not: criterion.` (source: answer A2, commands answer in JSON with `ok`, not by exit code). Readings: (1) approve the new wording, so the glossary matches design-decision/commands-and-agents-answer-in-json [recommended]; (2) keep the old wording, which then contradicts the lines that give `ok` and exit 0 on any non-crash; (3) another wording, which the person gives.
